displayName: Poshmark API - Sold Prices, Listings, Closets, Love Notes
description: Poshmark API for Poshmark sold prices - search sold Poshmark listings by keyword on Poshmark US (USD) and Poshmark Canada (CAD) with the price shown on the sold listing and the date Poshmark marked it sold, filtered by brand, department, category, size, condition, colour and price (up to 480 sold listings per query and filter combination), next to active listings with the original price the seller entered, the first listed price and price drops (about 5,000 per query). Read one listing in full, a category or brand grid, a closet (seller) with items sold, followers and Love Notes count, its listings for sale or sold, and its latest 100 Love Notes. Plus closet search, the category tree, the top 50 brands, suggestions, Posh Parties with their listings and similar listings. 15 endpoints, 1 credit per call. No offers, bundles or price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
